smell: `Atom.make((get) => { ...; return undefined; })` returns undefined from a mounted binding atom.

exception.reason: The return position is the reactivity mount/finalizer boundary; undefined means no cleanup, not domain absence.

smell: `return null;` appears in Vite config/plugin code.

exception.reason: Vite plugin/config hooks use null as a framework sentinel for no transform/result.

smell: Node-style write callback receives `(error?: Error | null)` and checks both undefined and null.

exception.reason: The nullish error parameter is inherited from the Node stream callback contract; wrapping it in Option would obscure, not move, a framework boundary.

exception.reason: These are rendering-time key fallbacks over bounded UI arrays, not schema-field defaults; `boundedKey` is also a trust-boundary/performance guard over attacker-influenceable streamed content.
